I agree with the Dothrak part, doesn't matter how good they fight they are light cavalry and shouldn't be charging into anything, some kind of Dotharaki version of a Cantabrian circle would be better I think.

Catapults were poorly positioned but I think fighting outside the walls was necessary, I think if they were all on the inside it would have been a moshpit, which is in the wights favour.

Archery, yeah nothing really happened here, although winds were super strong so who knows.

I still liked the episode though, ignoring tactical mistakes it created a sense of doom which I wasn't sure they would pull off, the bodies falling from the sky into a swamp of bodies and few soldiers trying to survive made it look like actual hell.

Brayshaw is just competing against Fyfe, Mundy, Langdon, Hill and Walters who are all playing their best football at the moment. It's hard to get the ball when they are all hogging it. Cerra is doing fine, not expected to get too much of the ball in half back but he is spoiling and his disposal is good. The thing is even if they aren't getting the ball too much they aren't losing contests, they are competing fine, they aren't playing bad at all and don't deserve to lose their spot in the slightest.

Leigh Mathews calls a players first 50 games an apprenticeship of sorts and Cerra/Brayshaw are only half way through that with 27 & 23 games, I wouldn't expect them to be game changers for at least another 2 years.
Love watching Fyfe just run through people.

Conca might end up coming out for Blakely based on stats alone, but I think Conca also brings leadership and he's tough which we need.

Maybe McCarthy comes out and Brayshaw spends more time up forward so we have Fyfe, Mundy, Conca and Blakely in the middle, that's a pretty good experienced midfield with Hill and Langdon on the wings. But I like Cam even if he has shit games every now and then.
